neighbours.label: a praising adjective or possessive just before 'work' or its like (keep up the good work, important work, their incredible efforts)
fire: As we do this long, important work, we learn together.
Keep up the good work, and thank you.
Thanks and keep up the great work on the site.
10% goes to support their amazing efforts to clean rivers.
Please continue to support the hospital's important research.
The best way to thank them is to continue their mission.
Her vital work on malaria saved many lives.
We admire your excellent work with the children.
quiet: As we do this long, boring walk, we chat together.
Keep up the speed, and thank you.
Thanks and keep the dog on the site.
10% goes to pay their monthly fees for rivers.
Please continue to park near the hospital's front door.
The best way to reach them is to take their road.
Her vital signs on Monday were normal.
We saw your old car with the children.

notes: Direct logits promote ' work', ' important', ' done'. 'Keep up the speed' reached 0.42 on ' the', so ' keep up the' fires by itself; that is a near miss here too.
